Browser mode 'always' uses browser even for normal server-rendered pages

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
import os
from crawlberg import BrowserConfig, CrawlConfig, create_engine, scrape

async def main() -> None:
    engine_config = CrawlConfig(browser=BrowserConfig(mode="always"))
    engine = create_engine(engine_config)
    url = "https://example.com"
    result = await scrape(engine, url)
    print(result.browser_used)

asyncio.run(main())
```
